spell.frozen_dominion_spells.avalanche.g: A wave of ice chunks rolls out along the ground before you, hurling aside, slowing and wounding everything in its path. It climbs a step and drops down two; a wall stops it.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.icicle_rain: Where you look, shadows darken the ground one after another - and over each an icicle falls out of the air and bursts, chilling whoever still stands there.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.frost_javel: Hurl a javelin of ice. Into a foe it drives home and chills; into the ground it stands as a pillar of ice - cover to hide behind, and a creature that runs into it is stunned.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.frost_shack: Chains of ice tear up out of the ground round the foe you point at and hold it where it stands: it can neither walk, nor jump, nor be pushed away until they snap.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.frost_heart: Set a heart of ice upon the ground. With every beat a ring of frost runs out from it, wounding and slowing what it passes. It beats until its time runs out - or until something breaks it.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.rune_litany: Runes of ice gather and circle you. Each time you wound something - with a spell, a blade or an arrow - one rune breaks from the ring, flies at it and freezes it.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.ice_sentine: Raise a sentinel of ice with a tower shield and a sword. It keeps by your side, attacks what you fight, and turns blows from the front aside with its shield.
spell.frozen_dominion_spells.frost_shell: A shell of ice closes round you and takes the blows. When it is spent - or its time runs out - it bursts, and its shards cut everything round about.
